ritual.constraint: One new sentence at this level — not one of these {sentenceCount} — in your notebook. Up to {maxWords} words, only words you’ve learned.

check.copy: Now check it yourself — ask someone who knows Spanish, or dig on the internet. Checking is your job, not the app’s.
check.resourcePerson: Anyone who knows Spanish — a friend, a colleague, family. Ask them; that’s the surest way.
check.resourceInternet: The internet, yourself — a dictionary, a search: whatever method feels right.
check.caption: No buttons in this step — deliberately. This work happens outside the app.

confirm.holdLabel: I wrote my {ordinal} sentence and checked it myself — press and hold

retry.title: Fresh sentences, once more.
retry.body: One answer came out different — that’s fine, that’s information. Take two fresh sentences from the pool and compare calmly.
retry.reassure: Unlimited retries. The rung waits; nothing is counted against you.

ladder.pendingLine: Level {level} · {remaining} of {total} rungs still to climb. The levels above wait sealed. Go as far as you want — the sequence is the system’s, the pace is yours.
ladder.ownership: Yours to pace. Practice any rung you’ve passed, anytime — keep the app or delete it. The ladder stays where you left it.
ladder.sealedToast: Sealed — Level {level} opens when the rungs below it are climbed: {remaining} left.

rungCard.freshNote: Read it through once — Practice picks up from there. Nothing is locked; the tab stays open.

module.helper: Tap a card for a quick summary; open full for everything. Two got-its per sentence opens the exit ritual.

practice.hubProduce: {count} sentences to write in your notebook
practice.nothingDue: Nothing due yet — this is the first rung.
practice.summaryAtTwo: {count} of {total} sentences now stand at two.
practice.resumeLine: Your last session is still open — {phase}, card {count} of {total}.
practice.resumeContinue: Pick it up where you left it

pendingAuthoring: The sentences for this rung are still being written — they’ll land right here once someone who knows Spanish has checked them. Until then, practise the rungs behind you; the ladder isn’t going anywhere.

verdict.checkSentence: The {ordinal} sentence — written in your notebook, new, at this level.
verdict.checkChecked: Checked by you, in your world — your resources, your call.
verdict.honesty: The app graded nothing. It saved nothing you wrote. That was the deal.
verdict.line: Your sentence, your Spanish — the app checked nothing and saved nothing. The next rung is open — {nextModule}.

settings.statusPending: Level {level} · {passed} of {total} passed · the next rung is pending authoring
settings.switchNote: Switching never erases anything — each course keeps its own ladder, review queue and counters. Come back anytime; it’s exactly where you left it.
settings.storageProtected: Storage is protected — the browser has agreed not to clear your progress to free up space.
settings.storageBestEffort: Storage is best-effort — under pressure the browser may clear it. Your export file is the real backup.
settings.backupNote: One file carries every course out — ladder positions, counters, review queues, session positions. None of your writing is in it, because the app never has it. It goes only where you send it.
settings.importReplace: Importing replaces your current progress in every course with what this file holds — a session left open here goes with it. Check both sides below before you decide.
settings.importFailed: This file could not be read, so nothing was changed.
settings.privacy: After install this app never talks to the internet — only the export file you share ever leaves the device.

switchToast: You’re on {to} now. Your {from} ladder is saved exactly where it was.
importToast: Backup restored — every ladder is exactly as the file held it.
storageNote: What you wrote isn’t in here — the app never keeps it.
notebookInvitation: Your notebook is your workbook — nothing is written inside the app.
